content:
Today is 2026-11-14. Tear down this product. The sites below are not reachable from this run. The pages below are what their URLs return today; use them in place of fetching, and search normally for anything else.

Whiteboards your whole team actually uses

Slatebird is an online whiteboard for product and design teams. Share any board with a link; guests can comment without an account. Free for up to 3 boards; Team plan $9 per editor per month.

Refer a team

Give a friend's team one free month of Team. When they upgrade, you get one free month too. Up to 12 months.

Template gallery

1,400 community templates for retros, user story maps and roadmaps. Every template page shows "Made with Slatebird" and a "Use this template" button that opens a free sign-up.

Slatebird reviews (4)

2026-10-02, 5 stars: "Fastest whiteboard we've tried, boards load instantly."

2026-09-18, 5 stars: "Snappy even with 40 people on one board."

2026-08-30, 4 stars: "Speed is the reason we switched from our old tool."

2026-08-11, 2 stars: "The mobile app is clunky and crashes on my tablet."
